name: updateHospitalSettings
shortDescription: Allows administrators to configure system-wide settings such as operating hours, holidays, and policies, with an auditable record of changes.
description:
Overview

Provides functionality for hospital administrators to update system-wide configuration settings. This includes managing hospital operating hours, holidays, and various policies, ensuring that all changes are auditable.

Intended use

Called by the admin dashboard UI when an administrator modifies hospital configuration settings.

Logic

  1. Validate input parameters for hospitalName, operatingHoursJson, holidaysJson, policiesJson, etc.
  2. Retrieve the singleton HospitalConfiguration record using ctx.data.get.
  3. Update the HospitalConfiguration record with the new settings using ctx.data.update.
  4. Audit-log the configuration change, including details of what was updated, using ctx.audit.log.
  5. Return the updated HospitalConfiguration.

Entities

  • HospitalConfiguration
